A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:P2P-L-deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor-PC-Errata-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, drawn anew at 1039 × 745 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2023 D-E1 card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
